newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Beirut lists on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Beirut lists on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: Bank of Beirut will begin trading its shares on the Beirut Stock Exchange on April 11, the BSE said on Monday.

"The Beirut bourse committee has accepted on April 3, 1997 the listing of Bank of Beirut's C shares in the bourse's official market. Trading will start as of April 11, 1997," the exchange said in a statement.
The BSE said no price has been set yet for the new stocks which amount to 30 percent of the bank's total shares.
The market has been awaiting the listing by Bank of Beirut whose $10 million private share placement prior to the listing was 11 times oversubscribed at $110 million.
The listing will bring to three the number of bank shares listed on the BSE. Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce began trading on December 30. Banque Audi shares made their debut on January 15.
Nine stocks by seven companies are currently trading on the BSE which reopened last year after 13-year shautdown during the 1975-90 civil war.
